definitions: To increase in amount or level.
To explode or be destroyed by fire.
To travel from a lower place to a higher place.
To be presented or performed (of a play, show, etc.).
examples: Prices are expected to go up next month.
A new building will go up on that site.
The old factory went up in flames.
We need to go up to the third floor.
The curtain will go up at eight o'clock.
